title: Origins Geokin
description: The official Geokin Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Geokin Origin

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Required Mods

- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui) (for the size)
- [Apugli](https://modrinth.com/mod/apugli) (To be able to eat the Ores)
- [Origins Extra Keybinds](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-extra-keybinds-fabric) (If you want to toggle the Nightvision)

Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.

### Origin Info

For ingame view check the Gallery for a cleaner view 

## Lore
A species that roams the caves looking for precious minerals and creating beautiful structers underground.

## Powers

### Burrow
Your strong upper body and large claws were made to dig and tunnel, allowing for ease of movement in soft stone.

### Dwarfish stature
Making your way through narrow tunnels has never been easier as a smaller creature, able to make your way through spaces half the size of a normal being.

### Inefficient body
You are not made to run.
Lose hunger faster while sprinting.

### Natural darkvision
You are adapted to life underground, making good use of limited light.

### Rock Eater
Due to your body composition and resources underground, you are adapted to consuming ores, and other similarly-based foods in your diet. You cannot digest normal food.

### Rock Infused
Some diseases cant affect you

### Skilled miners
You can naturally mine faster than others regardless of tool. You also mastered the art of dealing more damage with your mining tools

### Stone skin
Natural armor is granted to you by the stone which covers your body.

### Used to the darkness
Your wide eyes see best in darkness, making them weak and nearly useless in broad daylight. You are blind when in the open sun.
